data.one_liner: A Flutter package to pick, save, and manage files and directories on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows picking single or multiple files with extension and mime type filters, photo picker support, directory picking with persistent permissions, file saving from paths or byte data, and retrieving file metadata.
use_when: You need to pick single or multiple files on Android.
You need to save files from local paths or Uint8List byte data.
You need to pick directories and manage persistent URI permissions.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS, web, or desktop platforms since this package focuses on Android functionality.
You need a cross-platform file picker covering multiple operating systems seamlessly.
strengths: Supports directory picking with persistent URI permissions.
Allows disabling file caching to work directly with Android Uris and metadata.
Supports saving multiple files from both file paths and Uint8List byte data.
weaknesses: Limited platform support primarily centered around Android.
Requires managing native Android URI permissions and limits.
data.setup_notes: Works on Android 5.0 (API level 21) or later. Follow standard pubspec configuration.
